subject: Update sort_ro reply_schema to mention the null reply (#12534)
reason: The change only corrects documentation metadata: sort_ro.json's reply_schema now mentions the null element that SORT_RO with GET already returned, sort.json gets a whitespace-only description fix, and a TCL test is extended. No C code or generated command table changes, so server behaviour, replies, replication and persistence are identical on both builds — there is nothing a scenario could observe differing.
